newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Source One Q2 loss after charges.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Source One Q2 loss after charges.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1997 Q2 loss includes $6.0 million after tax extraordinary loss on the early retirement of debt, a $2.0 million after tax charge related to mortgage loans held for investment which have been identified for sale and marked down from amortized cost to current market value, a $1.1 million after tax restructuring charge related to a reduction in workforce and $.5 million after tax of other miscellaneous charges.

1997 six months net loss includes above items and a $2.8 million after tax loss on the sale of about $17.0 billion of non-recourse mortgage servicing rights to Chase Manhattan Mortgage Corp and a $.1 million after tax recovery of previously established valuation allowances related to the company's capitalized servicing asset offset by a $1.1 million after tax net loss on financial instruments.

1996 Q2 net includes a $4.9 million after tax recovery of previously established valuation allowances related to the company's capitalized servicing asset, offset by a $1.3 million after tax net loss on financial instruments.

1996 six months net includes a $17.9 million after tax recovery of previously established valuation allowances related to the company's capitalized servicing asset partially offset by a $3.2 million after tax net loss on financial instruments.

All of Source One's issued and outstanding shares of common stock are held by Fund American Enterprises Inc and Fund American Enterprises Holdings Inc. Source One's 8.42 percent Cumulative Preferred Stock, Series A trades on the NYSE under the symbol SOMpfA and its 9.375 percent Subordinated Debentures trades on the NYSE as SMQ.
Source One Mortgage Services Corp is full company name.
